# Downtown Seattle car parks

Five real garages from one tile of the Seattle region's PMTiles fixture at zoom 15, x 5248, y 11443,
decoded by `createProtomapsTerrainMvtDecoder`, with coordinates rounded to six decimals: Sorreano
(9 levels), Third and Stewart (9), Olympic (8), West Edge (8) and Cobb (7). `size` is the tile's edge
in world meters at this latitude.

These are the opposite of Bellevue Square's: small, tall plates of 1,100 to 2,800 m² on a street
grid rotated from north, where a ramp takes much of the floor. A layout that suits a suburban deck
leaves them with no stalls, or no ramp.
